fact: The 2024 state budget for the health mission, dated October 2023, lists under the leadership and support programme the activity 'development of the health information system' (تطوير المنظومة المعلوماتية للصحة) at 18,000 thousand dinars and a 'digital health programme' at 12,000 thousand dinars; the information-system line is a domestic budget line for the ministry's information system in general and does not name routine facility reporting.
title: ميزانية الدولة لسنة 2024 — مهمة الصحة
